grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and access your HMRC records

grants.description: Access your PAYE income records from HMRC to verify you meet minimum earnings
grants.purpose: To verify you earn at least National Minimum Wage for 16 hours per week and do not exceed £100,000 adjusted net income

grants.description: Access your Self Assessment records from HMRC if you're self-employed
grants.purpose: To verify your self-employment income and check income thresholds

grants.description: Access your partner's HMRC income records to verify their eligibility
grants.purpose: Both you and your partner must meet the working and income requirements

grants.description: Confirm your child's details including age and disability status
grants.purpose: To verify your child is eligible for Tax-Free Childcare and calculate the correct top-up limits

grants.description: Check if you or your partner receive benefits that affect eligibility
grants.purpose: To check you don't receive conflicting benefits (Universal Credit childcare element or childcare vouchers) and to verify if your partner qualifies through specific benefits

grants.description: Reconfirm your eligibility every 3 months by updating your circumstances
grants.purpose: To ensure you remain eligible for Tax-Free Childcare. Your account will stop if you don't reconfirm every 3 months.

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC Childcare Service helpline or revoke through your GOV.UK childcare account
revocation.effect: Your Tax-Free Childcare account will be closed. Any money in your account must be used or withdrawn. You will not receive further government top-ups.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payments into the childcare account or pay childcare providers on your behalf. Agent cannot decide which parent gets the account in separation cases - HMRC will make that decision. Agent cannot change your childcare provider without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot withdraw money from your account.
